preservedContactBarriers: Dotted, dashed and solid dark contacts that separate different classified palette families are retained; annotation-band repairs do not cross them.
rationale: Dark ink separating different classified colors is treated as a geological contact and is not bridged. Solid dark overprints on uniform color (roads, railway, text, ridge shading) are removed and filled from neighbouring geology. Small dark-outlined colored patches with interior labels are added as explicit seeds.
